plannerDivergence.issue: has() over an omitted attribute: unknown to the planner, absent to check()
plannerDivergence.reason: Before 0.57.0 the planner folds has() to true, so the plan is KIND_ALWAYS_DENIED. The per-row check() calls send the omitted aOptionalString as absent, so !has() is true and check() allows a2, a4, a8, c2 and e1. From 0.57.0 the plan carries the has().

trap: Before 0.57.0 the planner folded has() to true and the plan denied every row; NOT over a three-valued IS NOT NULL is still two-valued, so a translation that treats has() like a comparison (UNKNOWN on NULL) denies the rows it should return.
